primaryColor: 主体颜色，填写 #RRGGBB。Primary body color in #RRGGBB.
particleColor: 携带花粉时的粒子颜色；不需要可删。Pollen particle color; optional.
flowerBlock: 方块花源，例如铜块。只选一种 flower 字段。Block flower; choose ONE flower field.
flowerItem: 采蜜物品，放入机械蜂箱采蜜槽；不是繁殖食物。Item flower in the apiary feeding slot; not breeding food.
flowerFluid: 液体花源；机械蜂箱可用装有该液体的桶或兼容容器。Fluid flower; use a filled bucket/container in the mechanical apiary.
flowerTag: 花源标签 ID，不加 #；同时查看 tags/block 和 tags/item。Flower tag ID without #; see block and item tags.
flowerResource: Genesis 容器花源，按内容和最低数量匹配；不要同时写其它 flower 字段。Genesis container flower; contents and minimum amount; exclusive with other flower fields.
attributes: 初始基因；已有蜜蜂基因不会因改这里而重置。Initial genes; existing bees keep their genes.
weather_tolerance: 耐候：weather_tolerance.none / rain / any。Tolerance: none / rain / any (keep the prefix).
temper: 性情：temper.passive / normal / aggressive。Temperament: passive / normal / aggressive.
behavior: 作息：behavior.diurnal / nocturnal / metaturnal。Active by day / night / both.
endurance: 耐力：endurance.weak / normal / medium / strong。Endurance gene.
productivity: 生产力：productivity.normal / medium / high / very_high。Productivity gene.
createComb: 是否提供专属蜜脾外观；仍需单独写蜂箱产物配方。Enable a custom comb; does not create a production recipe.
size: 体型倍率，示例 0.7。Visual size multiplier.
speed: 飞行速度倍率，示例 1。Flight speed multiplier.
breedingItem: 繁殖时喂给这只蜜蜂的食物；跨蜂种配对另写 bee_breeding 配方。Breeding food; crossbreeding needs a bee_breeding recipe.
breedingItemCount: 一次需要的繁殖食物数量。Breeding food count.
selfbreed: 是否允许同种繁殖；不代替跨蜂种配方。Allow same-type breeding; separate from crossbreeding recipes.
waterproof: 是否防水。Whether the bee is waterproof.
fireproof: 是否防火。Whether the bee is fireproof.
conditions: 蜂种加载条件；缺少可选模组时不注册。Bee loading conditions; skip when a required optional mod is missing.
neoforge:conditions: 配方加载条件；改蜂种 ID、模组时一起改。Recipe loading conditions; update bee IDs and required mods together.
modid: 所需模组的 ID。Required mod ID.
type: 此处的类型 ID。配方 type 保留；蜂蛋 entity_data.type 改成你的蜂种 ID。Type ID: keep the recipe type; change entity_data.type to your bee ID.
parent1: 第一只亲本的蜂种 ID。First parent bee ID.
parent2: 第二只亲本的蜂种 ID。Second parent bee ID.
offspring: 子代蜂种 ID，填写一个字符串。Offspring bee ID as a string.
parentDeathChance: 亲本死亡概率 0–1；不填默认 0。Parent death chance; defaults to 0.
source: 转化前的蜂种 ID。Bee ID before conversion.
result: 转化后的蜂种 ID；合成配方中则是产物物品。Converted bee ID; in crafting recipes, the result item.
item: 物品 ID 或物品定义；按旁边的示例保留结构。Item ID or stack definition; keep the demonstrated structure.
ingredients: 无序合成材料；可按整合包进度调整。Shapeless ingredients; adjust to your pack's progression.
ingredient: 蜂箱配方写蜂种 ID；离心配方保留蜜脾及蜂种组件；巢穴配方写巢穴物品。Bee ID for hive recipes; comb+component for centrifuging; nest item for spawning.
results: 蜂箱产物列表，或巢穴生成的蜂种列表。Hive outputs or bees available from a nest.
biomes: 允许的群系列表或 #群系标签。Allowed biomes or #biome tag.
bee: 目标蜂种 ID，和蜂种 JSON 路径保持一致。Target bee ID; must match its definition path.
outputs: 产物列表。扩展产物最多 16 项。Output list; at most 16 extended outputs.
kind: 扩展资源种类，见 README 的种类表。Extended resource kind; see the README.
id: 实际注册 ID；原版物品使用 minecraft: 命名空间。Registered ID, including namespace.
energy_type: FE 能量固定填写 FE。Use FE for energy.
tier: 闪电等级：high_voltage 或 extreme_high_voltage。Lightning voltage tier.
data: AEKey 的完整数据；物品键的 id 必须与外层 id 一致。Complete AE key data; match the outer ID for item keys.
amount: 扩展配方和 flowerResource 使用带引号的正整数；PB fluid.amount 使用数字。Quoted positive integer for Genesis; numeric for PB fluid.amount.
chance: 概率，数字 0–1；1 表示必定，0.05 表示 5%。Probability from 0 to 1.
min: 每次最少物品数量。Minimum item count.
max: 每次最多物品数量。Maximum item count.
processing_time: Genesis 资源离心耗时，游戏刻；20 刻约一秒，默认 200。Genesis centrifuging ticks, default 200.
processingTime: PB 普通离心耗时，游戏刻。PB centrifuging time in ticks.
include_pb_outputs: true 时同时执行同蜂种的 PB 离心配方；两份配方都要保留。Also run the matching PB centrifuge recipe; keep both files.
fluid: PB 离心配方的液体产物。Fluid output of a PB centrifuge recipe.
components: 物品组件，不能省略蜜脾或蜂蛋的蜂种信息。Item components; preserve the bee identity.
productivebees:bee_type: 此蜜脾所属蜂种，必须与蜂种 ID 一致。Bee ID carried by this comb.
minecraft:entity_data: 蜂蛋生成的实体和蜂种；保留 id，只改 type 为你的蜂种。Spawn egg entity data; keep id, customize type.
count: 合成结果数量。Crafting result count.
items: 匹配的蜜脾物品 ID。Comb item to match.
values: 此标签允许的方块或物品 ID。IDs accepted by this tag.
replace: false 保留其它数据包加到标签里的内容。false keeps additions from other packs.
